content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm facing a basic issue in [product_name] and can't seem to resolve it. I have 8 projects that are mostly identical, using [product_name] with firmware [version_no], and the software version I have is [product_name] [version_no]. I've created my first project and need to copy it, make small modifications, and download it to another device. When I copy and paste the project folder to another location on the PC and open it, it appears empty. In short, I can't seem to copy the project successfully. Could someone clarify the correct procedure to achieve this? Thanks.

For your current setup with [product_name] ([version_no]), you need [product_name] [version_no]. Make sure to always run the software as an administrator. To duplicate a project, open the source project, then save it with a different name. For example: load 'project 1' in the application, save it as 'project 2', then repeat for 'project 3', etc.

What steps did you follow to open the copied project file? Sometimes it doesn't open correctly from Windows Explorer. Is the copied file's size the same as the original? If yes: 1. open the application first, 2. then open the project file, 3. check the results. If no: a. use 'save as' within the application, b. check file size again.

Hello [user_name], The box states '[product_name] [version_no] or later.' Do I need to upgrade to [product_name] [version_no] for full functionality? I also tried your suggestion—loading project 1, saving it as project 2, and so on—but the result is still an empty project.
Hello [user_name], I tried the 'save as' option too, but the project remains empty. Maybe you could record a short video demonstrating the process? Thanks.

Please consider uploading your project file. You can upgrade the software for free by downloading the update from [url]. Choose the version matching your operating system (32 or 64 bit). After downloading, run 'Setup.exe' as administrator and follow the instructions. After installation, always run the application as administrator.

A video likely won't solve the issue. What's the size of the copied project file? It might be locked—logging out of your Windows account could help. Check the file's ownership: right-click the file in File Explorer. See the example image above for normal conditions. Alternatively, copy the file via command prompt or PowerShell; the 'robocopy' command can help when Windows has trouble with file copying. Try searching for ways to take ownership of files if permissions seem to be causing problems.
Upgrading to the latest version can be beneficial. Just a suggestion—what happens if you compress (ZIP) the file and extract it to another location?
Thanks [user_name] and [user_name] for your helpful input.
Hi [user_name], Did you try the solution shown in the video? Was it helpful? If you still have issues, please update the thread and upload your project file for further assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing challenges when attempting to duplicate or transfer projects using [product_name]. The copied project files often turn up empty, causing confusion and frustration. Unclear workflows for file management, software compatibility concerns, and possible operating system or file permission issues are contributing factors.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate duplicating a project simply by copying and pasting its file within Windows, making small adjustments for deployment on multiple hardware units, and expect to do so without file corruption or losing project data.
